data.exact_reserve_text: The following tables show the development of gross and net claims incurred including IBNR and the claims handling provision over the last seven years.

prior_year_events.event_name: Licencing breach on a group life policy (UNFCU)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Estimated actuarial liability booked on the 2016 year of account for UK GAAP reporting.
Potential future losses reserved at a loss ratio of approximately 200% on a forecast ultimate premium, net of commissions, split across the 2016 and 2017 years of account.
Improvement during Q4 2017, reducing the loss on the 2015 year of account from GBP 3.0m to GBP 2.0m, resulting in an excess GBP 1.0m distributed to members.

named_events.event_name: Licencing breach on a group life policy (UNFCU)
named_events.loss_description: Estimated actuarial liability of GBP 7.7m booked on the 2016 year of account.
Reserved at a loss ratio of approximately 200% on a forecast ultimate premium, net of commissions, of GBP 8.9m split across the 2016 and 2017 years of account.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 308 experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 0.8m in prior year claims reserves, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This movement is part of the ongoing reassessment of claims incurred for previous accident years. Specific prior year events contributing to reserve movements include a GBP 7.7m strengthening for a licencing breach on a group life policy from 2011 (booked in 2016 YOA), and an GBP 8.9m strengthening for potential future losses from a group life investment scheme from 2016 (split across 2016/2017 YOA). Conversely, the 2015 year of account saw a GBP 1.0m release due to an improvement in its overall loss position.
raw_causal_phrases: reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
licencing breach on a group life policy
potential future losses from a group life contract covering investors in a particular investment scheme
reserved at a loss ratio of approximately 200%
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount is derived from the gross claims development triangle, as no explicit gross prior year movement figure was stated in narrative or notes. The narrative on page 36 states a 'deficit of GBP 5.2m ... relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years', which is a net figure and not used for the primary PYD amount.
